# Stormglide package assets

- `src/assets/sky.png` is the original generated Stormglide twilight background
  copied from the canonical game source. Its creation prompt and provenance are
  recorded in `the-miscalculations-of-lightning-girl/plans/assets.md`.
- `src/assets/fonts/*.ttf` are the canonical DM Sans and Fraunces font bytes.
  Their SIL Open Font License 1.1 notices are retained beside this record as
  `DM-Sans-OFL.txt` and `Fraunces-OFL.txt`.
- Canvas sprites and synthesized audio remain authored TypeScript; no external
  sprite or audio runtime is used.
